cards.name: The Fool

description.upright:
potential - new beginnings - freedom - innocence - naivety - optimism
The Fool represents infinite potential. This can signify the start of a new path. Tap into your sense of adventure. Embrace curiousity. Opportunities exist as long as you look for them. Now is a good time to try new things.
description.reversed:
recklessness - careless - immature - hesitant - apprehensive
You might not be paying attention to how your missteps are affecting others. Your enthusiasm can quickly lead to mistakes. Address your fears. Think about what is holding you back. Research and learn how to prevent future mistakes then confront the unknown.

cards.meaning: The Fool represents new beginnings, having faith in the future, being inexperienced, not knowing what to expect, having beginner's luck, improvisation and believing in the universe.

cards.name: The Magician

description.upright:
power - Skill - manifestation - concentration - creation - intention
A reminder that intention and perspective can be tools to manifest tangible outcomes. Creating your fate is not only possible but your sole responsibility. Create the world you want to see. Channel your desires. Contemplate dreams and breathe life into them
description.reversed:
scattered - directionless - distracted - trickster - illusions - charlatan
Healthy ambition can become ruthless manipulation. This can indicate a lack of clarity, or you may be unfocused with no place to devote your energy. Remember the foundations of your desire. Get back in touch with what you want. Consider tasks you can let go of that won't detract from your overall goal.

cards.meaning: The Magician represents your ability to communicate clearly, to 'sell' yourself and to be innovative. It is the embodiment of willpower, choice and desire. The Magician has all the tools and resources available to manifest his desired outcome.

cards.name: The High Priestess

description.upright:
intuition - sacred knowledge - divine feminine - subconscious mind
The answers you seek can be found within. A peaceful core knows your inner truth. What does your intuition tell you? Be mindful of your gut. Study your dreams. Listen to your inner voice. Trust your instincts.
description.reversed:
secrets - disconnected from intuition - withdrawal - silence - repression - superficiality
There may be a lack of understanding or a refusal to listen to your inner voice. You may be ignoring your intuition.. Slow down and devote some time to recharging and introspection. Trust your instincts.

cards.meaning: The High Priestess signifies spiritual enlightenment, inner illumination, divine knowledge and wisdom. She represents our relationship with our inner selves the mysteries of life that are beyond our understanding.

cards.name: The Empress

description.upright:
femininity - beauty - nature - nurturing - abundance
Show gratitude to the earth, sunshine, and wind. Find beauty, let it inspire you. Nurture your friends. Develop empathy. Ideas are coming more easily now. Venture into nature to feel more firmly rooted in your body.
description.reversed:
creative block - neglect - scarcity - codependence - over-nurturing - smothering
There may be a lack of creativity or abundance in your life. Alternatively, maybe your acts of love have become meddlesome and controlling. Consider what you can do to nurture yourself. Take time to care for yourself and your needs.

cards.meaning: The Empress signifies a connection with our femininity. She represents creation, abundance, nurturing, sunseuality and the strength of the divine feminine. She can represent the creation of life, romance, art, or business.

cards.name: The Emperor

description.upright:
authority - establishment - structure - father figure - logic - protection - masculine energy
It's time to take control of your life. You have the power to shape your future. Be assertive and confident. Set boundaries. Be a leader. Take action in a way that honors logic and reason. Protect what's yours.
description.reversed:
tyranny - domination - excessive control - rigidity - inflexibility - ineffective - avoidant
This might be a sign that you or someone close may abuse authority and hurt many in the process. Remember to maintain a healthy relationship with power and authority. Avoid becoming a tyrant. Be aware of when you say yes when you really mean no. Establish and guard your boundaries.

cards.meaning: The Emperor represents a powerful, commanding presence. He creates a solid foundation to build upon. He represents authority, structure, control, stability, and protection.

cards.name: The Hierophant

description.upright:
spiritual wisdom - religious beliefs - conformity - establishment - tradition - institutions
Being part of a social group can bring security and comfort. Learn from a mentor or take a class. Engage in traditions or rituals that are important to you.
description.reversed:
personal beliefs - conformity - challenging the status quo - unconventionality - social pressure - rebellion
Blind acceptance of the status quo may turn into the inability to accept change. Structure that normaly brings harmony may become stale. Individualists may draw judgement from those who follow the rules and may be shamed into conformity. Recognize where you feel alienated suppressed or alone. Consider what you can do to honor your own beliefs. Celebrate who you truly are.

cards.meaning: The Hierophant represents traditional values and institutions like schools and church. He can represent marriage, alliances, education, servitude, and the man to whom the Querent has recourse.

cards.name: The Hermit

description.upright:
solitude - contemplation - search for truth - inner guidance - introspection
Some answers only come when quiet settles in. Seek solitude. Meditate. Trust your inner voice. Find wisdom in silence. Look for answers within yourself.
description.reversed:
isolation - loneliness - withdrawal - lost - self-discovery
This may signal avoidance or that you've been led astray by anxiety, fear or projection. You might be unable or unwilling to check in with ones self honestly. Reflections of life may have become tainted or you may have become too withdrawn. Seek advice and actually listen to it. Reconnect with the world.

cards.meaning: The Hermit represents a period of introspection and soul-searching. It signifies the need for solitude and inner guidance.

cards.name: The Lovers

description.upright:
love - union - relationships - partnership - alignment - choices - commitment - duality
A relationship of trust, affection and balance. Think about the relationships in life that are truly tulfilling. Consider failed relationships and use the knowledge. to assess current situations or find a happy future. It is time to commit. Buckle down and make decisions.
description.reversed:
incompatibility - disharmony - imbalance - misalignment of values - selfishness - bad decisions
A relationship is no longer in harmony. Points to a lack of choice and reflects difficult decisions. Ask how you can use love to restore balance in yourself and with others. Make sure you are making decisions that are in line with your values.

cards.meaning: The Lovers represent balance and harmony in relationships. Think outside of the scope of romantic relationships and consider the other relationships in your life that are truly fulfilling.

cards.name: The Chariot

description.upright:
control - willpower - success - action - determination - focus
Remain foused, take control of the situation and ensure that goals are reached. Represents Strength in intention and willpower. Hold yourself accountable. Recognize what is distracting you and stay on course.
description.reversed:
lack of control - lack of direction - aggression - obstacles - failure - turbulence
you may be experiencing diminished confidence or motivation. This also may represent that there is an easier way or an easier path to take. Pause and consider the journey you are on. Reassess your goals. Ask if your prioritics are shifting. Rethink your approach.

cards.meaning: The Chariot represents control and willpower. It signifies success through determination and action.

cards.name: Strength

description.upright:
confidence - inner strength - compassion - courage - patience - self-control
Be patient and gentle with yourself. You have the strength to face any challenge. Despite distress, danger and struggle there is resilience and adaptability and confidence from success through life's twists and turns. Call on yourb inner strength regardless of opposing external discouragement. This is a signal to channel animalistic impulses into constructive action. Face your issues head-on.
description.reversed:
insecurity - self-doubt - weakness - raw emotion - self-limiting beliefs - lack of courage
There may be a lack of confidence or self-belief. This could also be a sign that darker, primal urges are not being kept in check. You may be feeling insecure or vulnerable. This is a time to observe your emotions before acting. Identify self destructive behaviors, anxieties and fears.

cards.meaning: Strength represents courage and compassion. It signifies the power of persuasion and influence.

cards.name: The Hanged Man

description.upright:
pause - surrender - acceptance - new perspectives - inactivity - sacrifice - suspension
It is time to let go of control. Surrender to the universe. Sacrifice may be necessary to achieve a larger goal. This is also a reminder that when the time is right for something, it will happen. Trust in timing and think of the larger goal. Look inward and focus on the things you have control over.
description.reversed:
stalling - needless sacrifice - delay - resistance - martyrdom - fear of letting go - being stuck
There may be a lack of control or a refusal to let go. This could also be a sign that you are resisting change. You may be feeling stuck or stagnant or a recent struggle might have shifted your perspective. This is a time to let go of control and surrender to the universe. Embrace new opportunities and accept the need for change.

cards.meaning: The Hanged Man represents a pause and surrender. It signifies letting go and gaining new perspectives.

cards.name: Judgement

description.upright:
judgement - rebirth - inner calling - absolution - self-evaluation - epiphany
It is time to evaluate your life and make important decisions. This is a time of rebirth and inner calling. You may be feeling the need to absolve yourself of past mistakes. This is a time to reflect on your past and make amends. Prepare for a rebirth of the soul.
description.reversed:
lack of self awareness - self-doubt - refusal of self-evaluation - inner critic
There may be a lack of self-awareness or a refusal to evaluate yourself. It may be a sign of ignoring a call to action. Answer the call of your heart. Don't avoid rebirth because of a fear of judgement. Embrace the opportunity to start anew.

cards.meaning: Judgement represents rebirth and inner calling. It signifies the need for self-evaluation and absolution.

cards.name: Temperance

description.upright:
patience - caution - thoughtfulness - balance - moderation - purpose
It is time to find balance and moderation in your life. This is a time of patience and thoughtfulness. You may be feeling the need to find purpose. This is a time to be cautious and considerate. Embrace the power of the universe.
description.reversed:
imbalance - excess - self-healing - re-alignment
There may be a lack of balance or moderation in your life. This could also be a sign that you are feeling out of alignment. You may be feeling the need to heal yourself. This is a time to find balance and moderation in your life. Embrace the power of the universe.

cards.meaning: A representative of the concept of alchemy. Temperance represents balance and moderation. It signifies patience and finding purpose.

cards.name: The Moon

description.upright:
imagination - fantasy - unconscious - cycles - imagination - speculation
The moon is a mirror of our internal. Our perception is affected by our internal narrative. Analyze daydreams and consider how they affect your interactions in reality. Examine your desires and motivations.
description.reversed:
confusion - self deprecation - anxiety - misunderstadings - delusion
Illusions are lifting—what was hidden is now becoming clear A blurry reality. What is real and what is just imagination? Reimagine why people behave the way they do.

cards.meaning: The Moon represents our dreams and our unconscious desires. It signifies intuition, illusion, and the dark side of our nature.

cards.name: The Star

description.upright:
hope - faith - renewal - spirituality - inspiration - serenity
It is time to find hope and faith in the universe. Use your light to guide others. This is a sign of healing and the discovery of inner strength. Your inner compass has led you through turmoil and chaos
description.reversed:
lack of faith - despair - self-trust - disconnection - hopelessness
There may be a lack of faith or hope in the universe. This could also be a sign that you are feeling disconnected. You may be feeling the need to find inner strength. This is a time to find hope and faith in the universe.

cards.meaning: The Star represents hope and faith. It signifies renewal and spiritual purpose.

cards.name: The Sun

description.upright:
positivity - optimism - success - vitality - warmth - fun - happiness
It is time to find positivity and success in your life. This is a time of warmth and vitality. This is a time to embrace the light and find happiness. Explore giving. Remember there is always light after the dark.
description.reversed:
negativity - depression - sadness - lack of enthusiasm
There may be a lack of positivity or success in your life. This could also be a sign that you are feeling depressed. You may be feeling the need to find happiness. This is a time to embrace the light and find positivity in your life. Consider new opportunities or a new approach.

cards.meaning: The Sun represents positivity and success. It signifies warmth, fun, and vitality.

cards.name: The Tower

description.upright:
catastrophe - hubris - sudden change - revelation - awakening
Major upheaval clears the way for new growth. This is a time of chaos and revelation. It is a time to awaken and find new opportunities. Embrace the unknown and find new paths. This change may be painful but it is necessary.
description.reversed:
personal transformation - fear of change - averting disaster
There may be a fear of change or a refusal to transform. Problems get worse the longer you ignore them.You may be resisting necessary change, or narrowly avoiding a crisis. This is a time to embrace your past crises. Learn from them and remember how you've grown from it.

cards.meaning: The Tower represents sudden change and upheaval. It signifies chaos and revelation leading to awakening.

cards.name: The Devil

description.upright:
shadow self - addiction - indulgence - temptation - materialism - bondage
Confront your shadow self. Have you been over indulging or allowing your addictions to control you? Identify the hole your addictions are trying to fill. Accept your imperfections.
description.reversed:
release - restoring control - reclaiming power - freedom
It is time to release yourself from the bondage of addiction. This is a time to reclaim your power and find freedom. Bring your secrets and shame to light with someone you trust.

cards.meaning: The Devil represents the shadow self and attachment. It signifies addiction, restriction, and exploring dark thoughts.

cards.name: The Wheel of Fortune

description.upright:
good luck - karma - life cycles - destiny - a turning point
Discover stillness in te chaos. Find serenity and be appreciative of all things that are fleeting. Identify what makes you feel grounded. Pay attention to repeating patterns.
description.reversed:
clinging to control - repitition - bad luck - breaking cycles
This is a signal to release control and let go before you get hurt. Detach your happiness from external events and praise yourself for external events. Clinging to control may be keeping you stuck. Accept the cycle of change.

cards.meaning: The Wheel of Fortune represents luck, karma and the inevitible. It signifies life cycles and a turning point in destiny.

cards.name: The World

description.upright:
fulfillment - completion - accomplishment - mastery - attainment
A long awaited goal is finally achieved. This is a time of completion and integration. You should celebrate your accomplishments. One journey is complete and leads to the start of another. Savor victory.
description.reversed:
incompletion - emptiness - lack of closure - disappointment - short-cuts - delays
This may indicate a need for personal closure or a tendency to take shortcuts. It's time to tie up loose ends. Be cautious of delays and reassess your approach to ensure a fulfilling journey. Regain your focus and find completion.

cards.meaning: The World represents completion and wholeness. It signifies accomplishment and the end of a journey. There is also the potential for travel.

cards.name: Ace of Cups

description.upright:
friendship - compassion - emotional fulfillment
A moment of emotional awakening. Fresh emotional energy can form new friendships or love.
description.reversed:
drained - represssed - empty - isolated - disconnected
Emotional suppression or lack of self-care may be causing disconnection.

cards.meaning: The Ace of Cups represents new love and new relationships. It signifies compassion and creativity.

cards.name: 2 of Cups

description.upright:
attraction - partnership - bonds
This is a sign of an equal partnership, romantic or platonic. Things are in harmony.
description.reversed:
inequality - imbalance - incompatibility - disharmony - lack of trust
Disharmony or emotional disconnect may be affecting a relationship. There is a lack of trust or communication. Find a way to restore balance.

cards.meaning: The 2 of Cups represents unified love and partnership. It signifies mutual attraction and harmony.

cards.name: 3 of Cups

description.upright:
friendship - social circles - party - collaboration - celebration
It's time to celebrate. Enjoy the company of friends and family. Gatherings are to be enjoyed. Have fun with the people around you!
description.reversed:
'three's a crowd' - isolation - gossip - third wheel - overindulgence
There may be a lack of celebration or even too much partying. This could also be a sign that you are feeling isolated. Find a way to reconnect with your peers and rekindle genuine friendships.

cards.meaning:
This is the Party Card! The 3 of Cups represents celebration and friendship. It signifies creativity and community, encouraging you to enjoy social gatherings and shared joy.
(This card is dedicated to my best friend KMC If you see this, I love you and I owe you dinner!)

cards.name: 4 of Cups

description.upright:
contemplation - detachment - apathy - reevaluation
It's time to take a step back and reevaluate your situation. This is a call to focus on the present.
description.reversed:
awareness - new experiences - enthusiasm - motivation
It's time to get back in the game. A sudden burst of awareness is on the horizon, keep an eye out for it.

cards.meaning: The 4 of Cups represents a time of introspection and contemplation. You may be feeling disconnected or unmotivated, but this card encourages you to look within and reevaluate your situation.

cards.name: 5 of Cups

description.upright:
regret - loss - grief - disappointment - pessimism
You may have feelings of loss, regret, or disappointment. This is a reminder to focus on what can be learned from the experience and to find a way to move forward.
description.reversed:
personal setbacks - self-forgiveness - moving on
Hardships are a chance to grow. Trust that you are ready to move forward.

cards.meaning: The 5 of Cups is a symbol of loss, regret, and disappointment. It is a reminder to focus on what can be learned from the experience and to find a way to move forward.

cards.name: 6 of Cups

description.upright:
revisiting the past - childhood memories - innocence - joy - recovery
Revisit happy memories from the past. Embrace your inner child and find joy in simple pleasures.
description.reversed:
living in the past - forgiveness - lacking playfulnes - no closures
Confront painful memories, but don't allow your focus on the past to take away from the present.

cards.meaning: The 6 of Cups represents nostalgia and revisiting happy memories from the past. It encourages you to embrace your inner child and find joy in simple pleasures.

cards.name: 7 of Cups

description.upright:
daysreaming - fantasy - illusions - decision
This could be a time of many options and opportunities. It is important to carefully consider your choices and avoid getting lost in wishful thinking or illusions.
description.reversed:
escapism - too much choice - personal values - overwhelmed
There is a need for alignment with personal values, but also the potential for feeling overwhelmed by choices. Illusions fade — time to make a grounded decision.

cards.meaning: The 7 of Cups indicates a time of many options and opportunities. It is important to carefully consider your choices and avoid getting lost in wishful thinking or illusions.

cards.name: 8 of Cups

description.upright:
walking away - difficult choices - withdrawals - abandonment
A delusion has been shattered. It's time to walk away from a situation that no longer serves you.
description.reversed:
fear of change - stagnation - avoidance
Avoid making a momentous change because of fear of the unknown. It's time to confront your fears and move forward.

cards.meaning: The 8 of Cups suggests a need to leave something behind and move on. It represents a journey of self-discovery and the pursuit of deeper meaning and fulfillment.

cards.name: 9 of Cups

description.upright:
contentment - satisfaction - gratitude - wish come true
The 9 of Cups is a card of contentment and satisfaction. It signifies that your wishes have been fulfilled and encourages you to appreciate the abundance in your life.
description.reversed:
gloom - disappointment - disillusioned - unfulfilled
Your wish may have been granted but all magic comes with a price. Something feels unfulfilling despite outward succes s— true joy may be missing. Is this what you really wanted?

cards.meaning: The 9 of Cups is known as the wish card. As all your needs are met, you are content and satisfied with your life and what you have accomplished. Be proud of yourself. Make a wish!

cards.name: 10 of Cups

description.upright:
home - love - blissful relationships - harmony - family - emotional security
Cherish your loved ones and find joy in your home life. This is a time of emotional fulfillment and harmonious relationships.
description.reversed:
disconnection - misaligned values - dysfunctional relationships - domestic disputes
There's turmoil building in your relationships. Something feels off. It's time to address the issues and find a way to move forward.

cards.meaning: The 10 of Cups represents emotional fulfillment and harmonious relationships. It signifies a time of joy, peace, and contentment in your home life.

cards.name: Page of Cups

description.upright:
creative opportunities - intuitive messages - curiosity - possibility - sensitivity - naive - imaginative
Create playfully. Listen to what your inner child has to say. Be open to new possibilities and trust your intuition.
description.reversed:
insecurity - gullible - rejection - wounded - emotional immaturity
Identify your insecurities and work to overcome them. Be cautious of being too gullible. Find a way to heal from past wounds.

cards.meaning: The Page of Cups represents your inner child. It encourages you to be open to creativity and to trust your intuition.

cards.name: Knight of Cups

description.upright:
romantic - charming - imaginative - idealistic - seductive - lover
Are you romantic or charming? Express feelings of love. Dress to impress. Appreciate beauty and creativity. Try to think like a poet would.
description.reversed:
vain - narcissist - unrealistic - jealous - moody - insecure
Beware of taking things too personally. Confront rejection directly without being passive aggressive.

cards.meaning: The Knight of Cups is romantic and sophisticated, a sign of emotional depth and creativity, and an appreciator of beauty and art.

cards.name: Queen of Cups

description.upright:
compassionate - caring - emotionally stable - intuitive - nurturing
Wise and comforting, but don't forget to balance caring for others with self-care.
description.reversed:
depression - avoidance - co-dependency - needy - self sacrifice
Consider the sacrifices you're making and how they are impacting you emotionally. Can you stop yourself from giving too much? Remember to set healthy emotional boundaries.

cards.meaning: The Queen of Cups represents compassion, care, and emotional stability.

cards.name: King of Cups

description.upright:
emotionally balanced - compassionate - diplomatic - wise
Take a calm approach and lead with emotional wisdom. Be a good listener and offer support.
description.reversed:
emotional manipulation - moodiness - volatility - repressed - bitter - wounded
Cope with your feelings maturely. Find release in a healthy way. Don't let your emotions control you.

cards.meaning: The King of Cups signifies emotional balance and compassion. He represents a mature and diplomatic approach to emotions and relationships.

cards.name: King of Wands

description.upright:
natural-born leader - vision - entrepreneur - honor
Harness your adventurous spirit to pursue bold ideas and expand your horizons.
description.reversed:
impulsiveness - haste - ruthless - high expectations
Pause to reflect before acting impulsively; adjust high expectations to avoid unnecessary pressure.

cards.meaning: The King of Wands represents a natural-born leader with a clear vision and the ability to inspire others. He is entrepreneurial and honorable, but can also be impulsive and have high expectations.

cards.name: Queen of Wands

description.upright:
courage - confidence - independence - social butterfly - determination
Build on your independence and confidence by pursuing creative or social endeavors that bring joy.
description.reversed:
selfishness - jealousy - insecurities
Work on balancing your emotions and addressing insecurities to strengthen relationships. Don't be a bitch.

cards.meaning: The Queen of Wands signifies courage, confidence, and independence. She is a social butterfly and determined, but can also be selfish and jealous.

cards.name: Knight of Wands

description.upright:
energy - passion - inspired action - adventure - impulsiveness
Harness your adventurous spirit to pursue bold ideas and expand your horizons.
description.reversed:
haste - scattered energy - delays - frustration
Focus your scattered energy on a single goal to avoid frustration or delays.

cards.meaning: The Knight of Wands represents energy, passion, and inspired action. He is adventurous and impulsive, but can also be hasty and experience delays.

cards.name: Page of Wands

description.upright:
inspiration - ideas - discovery - limitless potential - free spirit
Tap into your creativity to explore fresh ideas and embark on a journey of self-discovery.
description.reversed:
newly-formed ideas - redirecting energy - self-limiting beliefs - a spiritual path
Focus on nurturing your ideas and overcome self-limiting beliefs by embracing a growth mindset.

cards.meaning: The Page of Wands signifies inspiration, ideas, and discovery. He represents limitless potential and a free spirit, but can also have newly-formed ideas and self-limiting beliefs.

cards.name: Ace of Wands

description.upright:
inspiration - new opportunities - growth - potential
Pursue your passions and take bold steps toward growth and new opportunities.
description.reversed:
an emerging idea - lack of direction - distractions - delays
Consider refining emerging ideas and minimize distractions to reignite your motivation.

cards.meaning: The Ace of Wands represents new beginnings and opportunities. It signifies inspiration, growth, and potential, encouraging you to take action and pursue your passions.

cards.name: 2 of Wands

description.upright:
future planning - progress - decisions - discovery
Explore opportunities by aligning future goals with actions to move forward confidently
description.reversed:
personal goals - inner alignment - fear of unknown - lack of planning
Focus on inner alignment and overcome fears of the unknown to regain direction..

cards.meaning: The 2 of Wands signifies future planning and progress. It encourages you to make decisions and discover new opportunities, while also considering your personal goals and inner alignment.

cards.name: 3 of Wands

description.upright:
progress - expansion - foresight - overseas opportunities
Expand your horizons and embrace growth by planning for future endeavors.
description.reversed:
playing small - lack of foresight - unexpected delays
Address delays and shift perspectives to uncover new opportunities.

cards.meaning: The 3 of Wands represents progress and expansion. It signifies foresight and the potential for overseas opportunities, encouraging you to look ahead and plan for the future.

cards.name: 4 of Wands

description.upright:
celebration - joy - harmony - relaxation - homecoming
Embrace moments of celebration and nurture a sense of connection with loved ones.
description.reversed:
personal celebration - inner harmony - conflict with others - transition
Cultivate inner harmony and overcome external conflicts during times of transition.

cards.meaning: The 4 of Wands signifies celebration and joy. It represents harmony and relaxation, often indicating a homecoming or a time of personal celebration and inner harmony.

cards.name: 5 of Wands

description.upright:
conflict - disagreements - competition - tension - diversity
You might have to deal with an uncomfortable interaction or argument. Engage constructively in competition and use tension as an opportunity to grow.
description.reversed:
inner conflict - conflict resolution - diversity
Seek peaceful resolutions and focus on collaboration to reduce inner or external conflict.

cards.meaning: The 5 of Wands represents conflict and competition. It signifies tension and disagreements, but also the potential for conflict resolution and embracing diversity.

cards.name: 6 of Wands

description.upright:
success - public recognition - progress - self-confidence
Celebrate your accomplishments and use your momentum to inspire others.
description.reversed:
private achievement - insecurity - egotism
Focus on building self-confidence by addressing insecurities and redefining personal success

cards.meaning: The 6 of Wands represents success and public recognition. It signifies progress and self-confidence, but can also indicate private achievement and insecurity.

cards.name: 7 of Wands

description.upright:
challenge - competition - protection - perseverance
Stand your ground and defend what matters most to you with courage and resilience.
description.reversed:
giving up - overwhelmed - defensive - paranoia
Reflect on feelings of overwhelm and find a balanced approach to handling stress.

cards.meaning: The 7 of Wands represents challenge and competition. It signifies protection and perseverance, but can also indicate feelings of being overwhelmed or defensive.

cards.name: 8 of Wands

description.upright:
movement - fast-paced change - action - alignment - air travel
Take advantage of opportunities requiring swift action and clear focus.
description.reversed:
delays - frustration - scattered energy - slowing down
Reassess priorities and slow down to avoid scattered energy or frustration

cards.meaning: The 8 of Wands represents movement and fast-paced change. It signifies action and alignment, but can also indicate delays and frustration.

cards.name: 9 of Wands

description.upright:
resilience - courage - persistence - test of faith - determination
The 9 of Wands represents resilience and courage. It signifies persistence and boundaries, but can also indicate struggle and feelings of being overwhelmed.
description.reversed:
struggle - overwhelm - defensive - rigidity
The 9 of Wands reversed suggests struggle and stubbornness, also the potential for feeling overwhelmed, defensive, and experiencing paranoia.

cards.meaning: The 9 of Wands represents resilience and courage. It signifies persistence and boundaries, but can also indicate struggle and feelings of being overwhelmed.

cards.name: 10 of Wands

description.upright:
burden - extra responsibility - hard work - completion
Focus on prioritizing tasks to release unnecessary burdens and achieve balance.
description.reversed:
doing it all - carrying the burden - delegation - release
Take a step back to delegate responsibilities and regain clarity. You don't have to do everything on your own.

cards.meaning: The 10 of Wands represents burden and extra responsibility. It signifies hard work and completion, but also the need for delegation and release.

cards.name: Ace of Swords

description.upright:
breakthrough - clarity - sharp mind
The Ace of Swords represents a breakthrough or moment of clarity. It signifies a sharp mind and the ability to cut through confusion and chaos.
description.reversed:
confusion - brutality - chaos
The Ace of Swords reversed suggests confusion, brutality, and chaos.

cards.meaning: The Ace of Swords represents a breakthrough or moment of clarity. It signifies a sharp mind and the ability to cut through confusion and chaos.

cards.name: 2 of Swords

description.upright:
difficult decisions - weighing up options - an impasse - avoidance
The 2 of Swords signifies difficult decisions and weighing up options. It represents an impasse or avoidance, and the need to make a choice.
description.reversed:
indecision - confusion - information overload
The 2 of Swords reversed suggests indecision, confusion, and information overload.

cards.meaning: The 2 of Swords signifies difficult decisions and weighing up options. It represents an impasse or avoidance, and the need to make a choice.

cards.name: 3 of Swords

description.upright:
heartbreak - emotional pain - sorrow - grief - hurt
The 3 of Swords signifies heartbreak and emotional pain. It represents sorrow, grief, and hurt, but also the potential for releasing pain and finding forgiveness.
description.reversed:
negative self-talk - releasing pain - optimism - forgiveness
The 3 of Swords reversed suggests negative self-talk, but also the potential for releasing pain, finding optimism, and forgiveness.

cards.meaning: The 3 of Swords signifies heartbreak and emotional pain. It represents sorrow, grief, and hurt, but also the potential for releasing pain and finding forgiveness.

cards.name: 4 of Swords

description.upright:
rest - relaxation - meditation - contemplation - recuperation
The 4 of Swords represents rest and relaxation. It signifies a time for meditation, contemplation, and recuperation.
description.reversed:
